entities.summary: Archaeological site containing the remains of a promaucae fortress, later used by the incas, located on the large hill overlooking the village of la compañia, graneros, chile, it is the southernmost building which remains of the inca empire Created c. 1310. Pukara de La Compañia is a archaeological site from Americas, created circa 1310. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
